scope: PostgreSQL 17.4 qualified Cardinality classification, explicit single-Field carriers and retained native/ideal recovery

regression.scope: All tests/core, tests/core-ideals, tests/postgresql, tests/sqlserver, tests/tablespec, tests/avro and tests/parquet test files except field-conformance.test.ts and nullability-conformance.test.ts, both run separately after evidence refresh.

criteria.AC1: Classification and projection tests cover positive, refusal, approximation, unknown, nested/cyclic items and both recovery directions
criteria.AC2: Pinned native combined command executes scalar and array/JSON probes and composed capture/classification/recovery checks
criteria.AC3: Real Chromium and pinned optional WASM syntax backend match native results and recover JSON/YAML receipts; no host globals or external requests
criteria.AC4: All schemas pass audit; item references, container/member availability, unknown metadata and strict/report boundaries have explicit tests

limits: TableSpec and PostgreSQL qualification does not run the separate Cardinality ideal admission or all-five gate; SQL Server, Avro and Parquet remain pending.
Classification covers paired catalog/type observations on PostgreSQL 17.4; browser agreement does not authenticate database snapshot provenance.
Basic scalar shape is independent of value range, exactness, identity and availability.
Native arrays retain rank/lower-bound/domain refinements; checked sequence projection reports homogeneous item constraints.
JSONB object projection retains key/value-domain losses; native-only reclassification remains unspecified and cannot reconstruct author map intent.
Nested/cyclic item references, independent availability and unknown metadata remain in receipts with explicit residuals; no recursive native type or value conversion is fabricated.
Regression scope covers core and five priority systems, not the entire repository.
